entry_points.text: Sysfs shows and stores for config trigger reset result thread count driver filesystem and case; stores return input count or negative error, shows return rendered length, trigger and reset serialize through nested mutexes.

Load registers one device and fails when none results, optionally forcing driver then filesystem runs and returning first warned failure; unload walks global list safely under registration lock, stops tests under nested locks, logs, unregisters misc, unlocks reverse and frees.

Lockup entry records main task, maps letters to wait states, validates locks and magic, refuses sleep with atomic captures, optionally derives locks from file, fans out or runs locally, reports timing and allocation failures with retry unless interrupted; KHO exit removes subtree at stored folio address then unpreserves releases and frees data and tree folios.
Init-time checks cover backward traversal, null stores, root expansion with tags, deficient nodes, gap combining, bulk overwrite stress and repeated perf loops for stores walks loads and iteration.

exports.text: Each instance registers a dynamic-minor misc device named from base plus index and exposes a sysfs group for config, trigger, reset and result.

hazards.text: Unexpected case selectors abort via fatal check in release dispatch and tally; maple helpers treat unexpected return position or value as fatal tree check, halting rather than soft-failing.

Release flag is never cleared after release so stop sanity pass can attempt second release; single memory flag short-circuits launch and trigger until reinit or typed run clears; init and trigger warn on exhaustion and unexpected positive return.
Device-count guard tests exact equality against max int after increment, so mutation outside registration lock could bypass the limit.

Numeric lock addresses cast without ownership tracking risk corrupting unrelated state if stale or wrong; sleep with atomic captures is refused only for checked combos, leaving misconfiguration or concurrent control mutation able to place sleep inside atomic region.

Closed-interval rescans plus neighbour probes assume ordered bounds and representable neighbours with quadratic cost on large maxima; synthetic allocation pressure must be restored and tree destroyed or later scenarios distort.

invariants.text: Force flag defaults false and start strings default null; init prefers start driver over built-in default, copies start filesystem only when present, selects driver case, zeroes result, and sizes threads from loader limit or fifty.

Text stores replace pointers under protection with bounded allocation and report count or no-space; frees null pointers; info sync reallocates zeroed array by thread count; uint sync parses decimal with rollback retry and warn on failure; ranged and signed updates validate then store; shows snapshot under protection as one line with empty marker.

Trigger runs dispatch under nested locks, normalize success to zero and keep outcomes in stored result; typed run sets case and silently skips filesystem run when unconfigured; workers request module or lookup filesystem, clear own handle under protection and bump completion; tally records last nonzero slot error; stop halts remaining handles then rechecks releases.

Registration serializes globally, rejects count at max int, links on success and frees on failure; device helpers chain device to driver data to container; case names map driver and filesystem values with invalid fallback; logs prefix module name.

Timing and lock controls default idle with one iteration, running state, and zero addresses; running wait busy-delays while sleeping waits use hrtimer or jiffies; fan-out pins online CPUs, records master, queues one high-priority work per CPU then flushes; addresses aliasing userspace or failing fault-free read reject, with optional magic checks and required mm or file context.

Singleton insert must succeed once then conflict on duplicate; range store and insert assert status then re-read every index; loads compare stored pointer or index encoding; sequential builds revalidate prior entries plus gap; split tests probe halved and doubled billion-scale addresses; forward reverse and bounded finds return ordered values with null on gaps.

Allocation mode supports appends and overwrites with validation; forward placement returns lowest fitting gap and reverse returns highest with busy on unsatisfiable; perf loops build strided intervals then repeat clear restore overwrite load walk and iteration; dump validate shrink and non-kernel helpers are empty with atomic run tallies.

locks.text: Trigger mutex nests outside config mutex on run and reset; allocation sets three per-device mutexes plus completion; global registration mutex nests outside per-device teardown.
Config mutex guards driver and filesystem text, thread count, case and result across all shows stores updates copies frees and syncs.
Thread mutex guards slots handles completion counting and aggregation; launch stop tally and worker clear all hold it.

Lockup order is mutex then semaphore then mmap, then irq softirq preempt and RCU captures, then spinlock and rwlock with address locks master-only; release reverses; read mode follows shared flag; peak wait recorded by compare-exchange with rate-limited report.

Maple read-only scans run in RCU sections, stateful scans hold iterator lock with explicit release across pause, and empty-area probes hold state lock with reset between probes; mutating sequences hold exclusive cursor guard.

state_machines.text: Fan-out launches workers sequentially, aborting if memory flag set or launch fails; clean launch waits for all then aggregates; failure marks exhaustion, stops runners and reports exhaustion.

Dispatch resets done count then selects driver or filesystem by case, warning and rejecting when filesystem unconfigured or case invalid; init builds clean config or sets memory flag warns frees and propagates; reset repeats under nested locks; lifecycle moves alloc to setup to registration to list to optional runs to stop to deregistration to staged free.
Probe tries subtree retrieval first; on success restores and reports restore outcome, on missing entry falls through to save, on other error warns and propagates.

Worker announces start, acquires locks and preallocates, then iterates until bound or signal; each pass optionally marks iowait, waits run interval, frees pages, drops locks, touches watchdogs and yields, waits cooldown, then reacquires and reallocates; finish logs time frees and unlocks.

Cursor holds position and interval; lookup establishes covering entry, forward advances to upper bound and reverse retreats to lower bound reporting absence past bound; supports reset, pause across unlock relock, and erase preserving neighbours; reverse empty search moves start to highest fitting span within limits.

structs.text: Config holds nullable driver and filesystem text, thread count, case selector and aggregated result; per-thread slot holds statuses, task handle, index, back link and release flag; device holds index, config, misc and device handles, three mutexes, completion and progress counters plus info array and list node.

File control bundles file and cached inode pointers with 256-byte path; maple node is nonempty when parent set or any slot set; traversal state holds tree reference, current interval, node reference with helpers for select restart emptiness height and root.
Case order is invalid zero, driver, filesystem, max with only middle two runnable; default thread count fifty; default driver test_module; default case driver.

Allocation ceiling 0x2000000000000Ul; 32-bit indicator true when slots exceed 31; ULONG_MAX ends key space; ALLOC_RANGE requests gap accounting; duplicate yields existence conflict and unsatisfiable allocation yields busy; debug selectors default disabled.

Page granularity is 12-bit shift; value encoding masks with positive long max; reverse fixture 200 entries stride 10 length 6; singleton scan 256 entries; split base 4096 with billion-scale huge values.
